author: Good Enough
description:
Objects appeared over the White House during one of the most famous UFO incidents in American history, leaving witnesses, radar operators, and military officials searching for answers. This Short explores what happened during the 1952 Washington, D.C. UFO sightings, why fighter jets were scrambled, and why the mysterious objects remain one of the most debated UAP cases ever recorded.

Discover the incredible events behind the Washington Flap and why this unexplained sighting continues to fascinate historians, pilots, and UFO enthusiasts decades later.
